instruction: I am currently using an Ubuntu system. Could you help me configure gedit as the default text editor?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting gedit as the default text editor in Ubuntu. Similar to the original VLC video player task, this uses xdg-mime to query the default application for text MIME types (text/plain, etc.). The evaluator checks if the default text editor contains 'gedit.desktop'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default text editor using xdg-mime for text MIME types (text/plain, text/x-log, text/x-readme)
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies if result contains 'gedit.desktop'
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns .desktop filename string, metric checks for substring inclusion
Expected value 'gedit.desktop' is correct for the gedit text editor on Ubuntu/Linux systems
Complete coverage of instruction requirement: task asks to set gedit as default, evaluator verifies it is set
No state timing issues: system configuration persists after task completion, no postconfig needed
New getter function uses appropriate Linux API (xdg-mime) and handles edge cases (returns 'unknown' if no apps found, raises exception for unsupported OS)
